scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
We High Wizards have
the responsibility of
using our destructive magic
for the right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
我们超魔导士有责任，将破坏性的魔法用于正道。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
A lifetime of training
is required before becoming
a High Wizard. Can you imagine
what would happen if our power
was placed in the wrong hands?!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
成为超魔导士，需要一生的修炼。
你能想象，这份力量若落入恶人之手，会发生什么吗？！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is time.
And Midgard has
need of those who can
wield the strongest of magic...
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
时机已到。
米德加尔特需要能驾驭最强魔法的人...

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Would you like to
become a High Wizard?
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
你愿意成为超魔导士吗？

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honors to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Congratulations.
As a High Wizard,
I hope use you use
your powers to bring
peace to the oppressed.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
恭喜。
愿你身为超魔导士，用自己的力量为受压迫的人带来和平。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[High Wizard]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[超魔导士]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
